shape.description: tuple or int The shape of the desired array. A single integer ``i`` is interpreted as ``(i,)``.

subok.description: bool, optional If True, then sub-classes will be passed-through, otherwise the returned array will be forced to be a base-class array (default).

output.description: ------- array A readonly view on the original array with the given shape. It is typically not contiguous. Furthermore, more than one element of a broadcasted array may refer to a single memory location.

constraints: The array must be compatible with the new shape according to NumPy's broadcast_shapes
